codeReview.summary: No actionable product defect found. Source removes appearance controls and preference handling while retaining light styling and existing interactions. Supplied results pass AC-2–AC-4; AC-1 fails because its tab-traversal assertion requires a focused DOM element even when focus leaves the page, not because an appearance control remains. Full AC-1 browser verification is therefore incomplete. Working tree is unchanged.

affectedTitles: [AC-1] Removed appearance UI is absent at desktop and narrow widths in both views and tab traversal
evidence: The actual failure at workload.acceptance.spec.js:83 is locator(':focus').not.toHaveText(/^(Light|Dark)$/) reporting 'element(s) not found', not finding a Light/Dark control. The preceding appearance-element, accessible-group and button absence assertions completed before traversal failed.

The generated test presses Tab 45 times and requires a focused DOM element after every press. Normal browser traversal can leave the document for browser chrome, at which point ':focus' matches nothing; Playwright's negative text assertion still requires an element. A conforming application without appearance controls can therefore fail this assertion.

The pinned AC-1 contract requires absence of appearance controls and their keyboard exposure, not a focus trap or continuous document focus. Read-only inspection found no appearance references in src files; src/main.js retains ordinary view/filter controls and handles only slash and Escape in its document keydown listener, with no Tab interception. index.html retains normal links, search and reset controls. Thus the missing-focus observation matches permitted native traversal, independently supporting the diagnosis rather than relying on the timeout or code-review opinion.
The supplied report records 14 passing cases and this single failure. AC-1 traversal verification remains incomplete; this diagnosis does not establish release readiness.

replacements.reason: Native Tab traversal can leave document focus for browser chrome. Snapshot the focused element's text and attribute without requiring a DOM match, then unconditionally assert both existing prohibitions after every Tab press. All 45 traversal steps, both widths and views, and all structural absence assertions remain intact; no focus trap is required.

result.rationale: Preparation succeeded; review was read-only and tests were not executed. The sole correction permits native Tab traversal to leave document focus, which the contract does not prohibit. Both negative checks still execute after every Tab, and unconditional structural assertions independently prohibit hidden or visible appearance controls. Empty snapshots therefore do not allow prohibited controls to escape. All shared helpers and remaining cases are unchanged. This approves test mechanics only, not application compliance; the inspected baseline still contains appearance behavior, so the supplied diagnosis's appearance-free source claim is not independently verified.

contract:
## Fixture and initial state
Controller-owned setup seeds `bma-playground.appearance.v1` with `dark`, removes `bma-playground.board.v1` and `bma-playground.focus.v1`, then opens the pinned preview. This uses the six default tasks from src/board.js without resetting the obsolete Dark preference. Initial view is Board, search is empty and teammate focus is All. `#filter-status` reads `6 tasks shown · All teammates`; `#progress-percent` reads `33%`; `#completion-count` reads `2 of 6 tasks`.

## AC-1 — Removed controls
`#appearance-control`, `#appearance-status`, `[data-appearance-option]` and the group named `Appearance` must be absent, not merely hidden. No replacement Light button or theme status is introduced. Verify absence in both views at desktop and narrow widths and through keyboard traversal.

## AC-2 — Light presentation
Use computed-style assertions independently of the recording: root color-scheme is `light`, page background is `rgb(243, 246, 252)`, ordinary task-card surface is `rgb(255, 255, 255)` and primary text is `rgb(24, 49, 79)`. Verify these with dark OS preference as well. Existing focus outlines, light fields and cream overload warning remain. `[data-view="board"]` and `[data-view="workload"]` remain named keyboard-accessible buttons in the `Launch view` group, with correct aria-pressed values and visibility of `#board`/`#workload`. No artificial visible theme text is added for assertions.

## AC-3 — Obsolete preference and reload
The appearance key is inert; there is no migration of board or focus storage. Under the seeded Dark fixture, both views retain the light computed styles before and after reload. Reload starts in Board because selectedView is not persisted, while teammate focus remains persisted. Independently seed a valid customized board with welcome status `doing`, owner `Erez`, effort `5`, and focus `Maya`; verify these fields survive startup and reload unchanged. Exercise unavailable storage and verify no appearance-specific announcement, while preserving the existing board save fallback.

## AC-4 — Existing interactions
Clicking `[data-view="workload"]` shows `#workload .workload-context` with `Active effort · To do + In progress. Totals include all tasks regardless of filters; Done adds zero.` and `#filter-status` with `4 active tasks shown · All teammates`. `[data-workload-owner="Maya"] [data-workload-load]` reads `12 / 8 points`; Erez reads `4 / 8 points`. Clicking `[data-teammate="Maya"]`, named `Maya` in the `Focus by teammate` group, changes the status to `2 active tasks shown · Maya` without changing either total. Reload returns to Board with `3 tasks shown · Maya`.

`#search` remains the task search input; its accessible name must identify task search. Filling it with `welcome` under Maya focus produces `1 task shown · Maya` and `[data-task-id="welcome"] h3` with `Polish the welcome screen`. Clearing the search restores the three Maya tasks. `#clear-filters`, named `Clear filters`, restores All and empty search and focuses the All button. `#reset`, named `Reset demo board`, resets the six-task fixture, clears drafts/errors/search/focus and announces `Demo board reset. Two of six tasks complete.` through `#announcement`.

Preserve `[data-status-for="welcome"]` named `Status for Polish the welcome screen`, its todo/doing/done values, drag targets `[data-column]`, and `[data-owner-for]`, `[data-effort-for]`, `[data-save-effort-for]` accessible labels derived from task titles. Independently verify drag and keyboard status edits, owner reassignment, valid effort commits, invalid effort retaining prior saved values, focus restoration, announcements, completion and capacity recalculation. Preserve `/` search focus and Escape clearing, storage normalization and unavailable-storage behavior. Independent acceptance covers these regressions; the recording below demonstrates view switching, focus persistence and search only.
